_field_notes.source_file: provenance: local file (path/bytes/sha256) OR a paste/import note.
_field_notes.scope: game, patch_mentions[], class, ascendancy, primary/related skills, content_scope[].
_field_notes.links: every non-PoB reference; each needs a stable source_id used by phase.source_links.
_field_notes.pob_links: every PoB; each MUST have a role (validator rejects orphan PoBs).
_field_notes.phase_model: player progression states in order: leveling -> ... -> endgame. Each: phase, main_skill, goal, entry, exit, pob_roles[], source_links[], skill_setups[], checks[]. Use foreign_build when leveling is a different build.
_field_notes.upgrade_nodes: upgrades. timing='midgame_sequence' (ordered via source_order_hint, prereq[] for hard deps) or 'anytime' (order-free). optional=true if skippable; soft_recommend[] for non-blocking advice.
_field_notes.knowledge_cards: atomic facts. Each: card_id, patch, tags[], summary, coach_use.

source.copyright_handling: structured summaries and links only; full source text is not stored verbatim
